layout_strategy.sidebar: Fixed width 280px dark panel with channel list, live status badge, clips today counter, and Quick Import Twitch link bar
layout_strategy.main_content: Flexible scrolling bento grid with top command header (Channel Filter, Sync Status, Past VOD Puller CTA), active channel tabs, and multi-channel clip feeds

grid_modes.clip_card_layout: Flex column with video/thumbnail player on top, floating caption overlay preview, chat hype spike mini-graph, AI title & hashtag badges, and quick copy CTA bar

key_features_and_components.name: Twitch Channel Link Manager
key_features_and_components.description: Input bar to paste Twitch channel links or @usernames, fetching channel avatar, stream status (LIVE badge + viewer count or Offline), stream category, and daily clip quota (default 24/day).

key_features_and_components.name: Live Status & Chat-Hype Spike Gauge
key_features_and_components.description: Real-time stream status indicator with pulse animation for LIVE channels, real-time estimated chat activity hype level (e.g. 98% Hype Spike - Fun/Creepy Moment detected), and toggle for auto-clipping.

key_features_and_components.name: Per-Channel Section View
key_features_and_components.description: Tabbed or stacked channel containers allowing users to view clips grouped per channel, configure individual channel settings (clips per day limit 1-100, chat spike sensitivity, prompt style).

key_features_and_components.name: Clip Card with Caption Overlay Preview
key_features_and_components.description: Rich clip preview with HTML5/Video player mockup, customizable animated text overlay preview (font style, position top/center/bottom, shadow, highlight colors), AI-generated viral title, formatted hashtags, clip duration, and Chat Spike timeline chart.

key_features_and_components.name: Pull-from-Past-Broadcast (VOD Engine)
key_features_and_components.description: Action dialog allowing users to fetch past VODs/livestreams from any linked channel, set time ranges or trigger automatic chat-activity peak scanning to pull clips on demand.

key_features_and_components.name: Social Copy & Export Station
key_features_and_components.description: One-click copy for Title + Hashtags, download high-res clip with embedded captions, or queue directly for TikTok/Reels/Shorts posting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, dark gaming dashboard with Twitch purple accents (#9146FF) and electric neon status indicators.
Implement full mock data and state handling for multiple Twitch channels (e.g. xQc, KaiCenat, Tarik, Pokimane, Shroud).
Provide a channel management bar to add new channels by URL (e.g., https://twitch.tv/username) with immediate feedback.
Show LIVE / Offline indicators with animated glow badges and real-time viewer counts.
Include a per-channel clips breakdown with customizable clip limit per day (default 24), and a pull past VOD clips dialog.

Provide interactive clip cards featuring video thumbnails, simulated playback, AI GPT 5.4 titles & hashtags, and on-video caption text overlay customizer (change position, background, highlight color, font size).
Include a chat spike visualizer showing moment peaks (Hype, Laughter, Creepy moment, Insane play).
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, and card has the exact data-testid attributes listed.
